title: HR Manager – Labor Hiring & Compliance
description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for an HR Manager with hands\-on experience in blue\-collar and labor hiring for our manufacturing/plant operations. The ideal candidate will manage end\-to\-end HR functions with a strong focus on manpower planning, labor recruitment.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**:

**Manpower \& Recruitment**

Plan, source, and hire skilled, semi\-skilled, and unskilled manpower for plant operations as per production requirements.

Manage bulk hiring drives, local contractor/vendor coordination for labor supply.

Handle white\-collar hiring for supervisory and support roles as required.

Execute bulk hiring for factory workers, machine operators, helpers, loaders, and technical Workers

Conduct recruitment drives in nearby villages and local communities.

Build and manage relationships with labor contractors, vendors, and manpower agencies.

Screen, shortlist, and onboard workers with proper documentation and KYC verification

**Contract Labor Managemen**t

Negotiate rates, terms, and SLAs with labor contractors as per company policy.

Monitor contractor compliance for PF, ESI, wages, and attendance of deployed workers.

Ensure timely payment to contract workers and resolve wage disputes.

**MIS \& Reporting**

Maintain daily labor deployment MIS, attrition data, and hiring pipeline.

Track cost per hire, source\-wise yield, and contractor performance metrics.

Provide monthly reports on compliance status and manpower cost to management.

**Education \& Qualifications:**

MBA / PGDM in HR or MSW / MLW from a recognized university.

Additional diploma in Labour Laws or Industrial Relations preferred.

**Experience**:

8–12 years of total HR experience with minimum 5 years in a manufacturing/plant environment.

Proven experience in high\-volume blue\-collar hiring and managing contract labor.

Strong knowledge of labor laws and compliance applicable to factories in Punjab.

**Key Skills:**

Strong liaison and negotiation skills with labor contractors and authorities.

Fluent in Punjabi, Hindi, and working knowledge of English.

Proficient in MS Excel, HRMS, and payroll software.

Ability to work in a plant environment and handle shop\-floor issues independently.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

title: India Benefits & AI Operations Intern
description:
### **About the Team \& Role**


Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Our Global Benefits team is dedicated to ensuring Rubrikans are supported through every stage of their journey.


As our **India Benefits \& AI Operations Intern**, you will play a pivotal role in our own AI transformation. Reporting to the Manager of India Benefits, you will bridge the gap between human\-centric support and cutting\-edge technology. Your mission is to audit, structure, and modernize our benefits data so it can be seamlessly leveraged by AI tools, ensuring our employees get the right answers at the right time.


### **What You’ll Do**


* **Build the Foundation:** Develop a fully functioning, AI\-ready knowledge base for all India benefits (employee\-facing) to provide instant, clear support.
* **Market Benchmarking:** **Research and benchmark India benefit trends and competitive offerings to ensure Rubrik’s programs remain market\-leading, inclusive, and aligned with our EVP.**
* **Optimize Internal Ops:** Create internal\-facing documentation for India and APAC benefits processing to streamline workflows for the Global Benefits team.
* **AI Data Auditing:** Review and refine existing policy documents to ensure they are structured for high\-performance AI tools like NotebookLM or similar LLM platforms.
* **Enhance Jira Service Management:** Build out and refine knowledge articles within the Jira help desk to improve self\-service capabilities.
* **Process Automation:** Identify and propose opportunities to leverage AI to automate manual benefit administration tasks.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with HR Operations and IT to ensure benefits data is accessible, inclusive, and accurate across all internal platforms.


### **What You’ll Bring**


* **Academic Focus:** Currently pursuing a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Data Science, or a related field.
* **Technical Curiosity:** High tech\-fluency with a deep interest in how Generative AI and automation can transform People Operations.
* **Communication Excellence:** Ability to translate complex benefit policies into simple, accessible, and inclusive language.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Strong attention to detail with the ability to audit large sets of information and conduct market research.
* **Problem\-Solving:** A proactive approach to identifying manual gaps and proposing digital\-first solutions.
* **Collaborative Spirit:** Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, global environment with a focus on team\-oriented outcomes.


### **Nice to Have**


* Familiarity with Jira Service Management or similar help desk ticketing systems.
* Basic understanding of India statutory benefits (EPF, ESI, Gratuity).
* Experience with data structuring or competitive research projects.


### **What You’ll Gain**


* **Impact:** You won't just be "learning"—you will be building the actual infrastructure Rubrik uses to support its employees.
* **Growth:** Direct mentorship from seasoned benefits leaders with over 15 years of experience in the India market.


**Empowerment:** The autonomy to experiment with AI tools and shape how we deliver benefits in the AI era.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

description:
**Job Description :**

**Context/Scope:**
==================


Global Diageo Business Services (GDBS) is a global multi\-functional Enterprise Operations entity that supports different parts of Diageo businesses across the World.


Diageo Business Service India (DBSI) is a Diageo Business Shared Services Centre (BSS) servicing the Diageo Africa, APAC, Europe, America \& South America markets. Processes in scope at DBSI are: Financial Planning \& Reporting, Finance Controlling, Source to Pay, Sell to Cash, Human Resource, Master Data Management \& Analytics, Application \& Technology Support etc.


Diageo also has other BSS and BSS partners that support service provision. The DBSI works closely with other GDBS Centers and markets across the Globe.

**Dimensions**
==============


The FP\&A Specialist is an individual contributor involved in data extraction, input, format, consolidation for markets/NAM stakeholders with basic analysis.


Also, regular engagement with teams of different departments including Market, FC, FP\&A team will be an integral part of this role..

**Market Complexity:**
======================

  

The FP\&A Finance team is responsible for supporting the Regional Diageo businesses, including Spirits, Beer, Supply and Corporate functions. FP\&A liaises with the various business finance and management teams to prepare our annual operating plan as well as forecasts through\-out the fiscal year.

**Purpose of Role:**

Analyze business processes and document "as\-is" and "to\-be" scenarios, considering the nuances of Indian payroll.
* **Solution Design \& Configuration (India Focus):** Design, configure, and test SAP Payroll for India, including components like payroll schema, rules, wage types, and tax calculations, ensuring adherence to Indian legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Income Tax, PF, ESI, Gratuity, etc.).

* **Training \& Documentation (India Focus):** Create user manuals, training materials, and other documentation specific to Indian payroll processes. Conduct end\-user training sessions for Indian payroll users.

* 8\+ years in SAP Payroll, with 3\+ years in **Employee Central Payroll (ECP)**.
* Strong knowledge of **Payroll Control Center (PCC)**, **BIB integrations**, and **EC–ECP data replication**.
* Experience with **payroll schemas, PCRs, off\-cycle payroll, and retro\-calculations**.
* Excellent understanding of **Time, Benefits, and Finance integration touchpoints**.
* SAP SuccessFactors ECP certification preferred.
* Strong client\-facing, leadership, and analytical skills.
* Bachelors or Masters in any field.

**The Team**

**Work you’ll do**
==================

  



As an SAP HCM Payroll Consultant, you will be responsible for implementing, configuring, and supporting SAP Payroll solutions for our clients in India. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand their specific payroll needs, translate those needs into technical requirements, and deliver effective solutions within the SAP HCM landscape, ensuring compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements in India.


* **Requirements Gathering \& Analysis (India Focus):** Conduct workshops and interviews with business users in India to gather requirements specific to Indian payroll, including statutory compliance, tax deductions, allowances, and other relevant areas. Analyze business processes and document "as\-is" and "to\-be" scenarios, considering the nuances of Indian payroll.
* **Solution Design \& Configuration (India Focus):** Design, configure, and test SAP Payroll for India, including components like payroll schema, rules, wage types, and tax calculations, ensuring adherence to Indian legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Income Tax, PF, ESI, Gratuity, etc.).
* **Statutory Compliance (India Focus):** Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of Indian payroll regulations and ensure that the SAP Payroll system is configured to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Manage and implement any changes required due to legal updates.
* **Customization \& Development (India Focus):** Develop functional specifications for custom enhancements related to Indian payroll and work with ABAP developers to ensure proper implementation. May also be involved in basic ABAP debugging related to payroll.
* **Testing \& Quality Assurance (India Focus):** Develop test plans, conduct unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) specifically for Indian payroll processes to ensure the quality and accuracy of SAP Payroll solutions.
* **Training \& Documentation (India Focus):** Create user manuals, training materials, and other documentation specific to Indian payroll processes. Conduct end\-user training sessions for Indian payroll users.
* **Go\-Live \& Support (India Focus):** Support the go\-live process for Indian payroll implementations, including data migration and post\-implementation support. Provide ongoing support to end\-users in India, troubleshooting payroll issues and resolving problems.
* **Project Management:** Contribute to project planning, execution, and tracking. Manage tasks and deliverables within assigned scope.
* **Best Practices \& Standards:** Stay up\-to\-date with SAP HCM best practices and Indian payroll regulations and trends. Contribute to the development of internal methodologies and standards related to Indian payroll.
* **Client Communication (India Focus):** Communicate effectively with clients in India, both verbally and in writing, considering cultural nuances. Build and maintain strong client relationships.

  


**Key Skills \& Experience:**
* 8\+ years in SAP Payroll, with 3\+ years in **Employee Central Payroll (ECP)**.
* Strong knowledge of **Payroll Control Center (PCC)**, **BIB integrations**, and **EC–ECP data replication**.
* Experience with **payroll schemas, PCRs, off\-cycle payroll, and retro\-calculations**.
* Excellent understanding of **Time, Benefits, and Finance integration touchpoints**.
* SAP SuccessFactors ECP certification preferred.
* Strong client\-facing, leadership, and analytical skills.
* Bachelors or Masters in any field.

title: Client Finance Analyst
description:
Overview:
**Work Location –** Hyderabad /Gurugram

**Experience –** 3 to 5 Years

**Shift Timing –** 6:30pm \- 3:30am IST (During Day light Savings: 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM IST)


**Hybrid Mode –** 3 Days Work from Office per week

**Mandatory Skills:** FP\&A (Budgeting, Forecasting, Variance Analysis), Billing knowledge, Excel, Financial Reporting, Vantage / D365 ERP \- added advantage, Excellent communication skills

 **About Role :**


The Client Finance Analyst is the day\-to\-day contact for the financial and operational matters detailed below with supervision and guidance. The Client Finance Analyst interacts regularly with Account Management and Project Management teams as well as agencies' shared service center. The Client Finance Analyst is responsible for assigned clients in addition to ad hoc projects. The Client Finance Analyst must understand and comply with client contracts as they relate to compensation, billing, compliance, financial reporting, reconciliation, and other deliverables.

 **Join us at OGS**  

We are OGS—Omnicom's Integrated Solutions Engine that brings together a global talent community and connected capabilities in data, creative, media, commerce, and technology to build adaptive, future\-ready solutions.


We are redefining the global capability center \- not as an offshoring hub, but as a true inside edge. OGS is the place where the future is tested, built, and scaled for the world’s most ambitious agencies and clients.


With over 4300\+ talented professionals in India, we are proud to be a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative community that thrives on innovation and excellence. Our teams work with some of the world’s most iconic brands, helping them move faster and achieve more—everywhere. We are growing rapidly and looking for passionate individuals to be part of this journey.

  

At Omnicom Global Solutions India, work is more than a job—it is a space to grow, thrive, and feel celebrated. We foster a culture built on integrity, respect, equity, pride, and belonging, offering a holistic employee experience that empowers real impact.


Responsibilities:
* Manage, open and review requests for all billable and client non\-billable jobs opening, closing, and locking as appropriate
* Own the job status of each project and ensure that when Account Management and Project Management request a change in status that Omaha executes swiftly and reports are updated
* Communicate job numbers to team members so timesheets are accurate and timely
* Coordinate with agency teams including Account Management and Project Management, as well as Client Finance Managers so estimates are entered correctly and timely, as well as updated and approved in the system
* Coordinate monthly billings with shared service center to ensure billing is completed by the deadline of each assigned client
* Check invoice for accuracy including but not limited to amount, billing address, and contact information, as well as the integrity of client billing contract requirements
* Monitor and add commentary monthly on the WIP report
* Ensure that out\-of\-pocket expenses are being billed timely
* Prepare, update, and analyze trackers weekly so all estimates, actuals, variances, and billing information are pulled accurately
* Schedule meetings to review trackers according to cadence for each team
* Analyze and call out to Client Finance Manager and/or internal teams if projects are running hot and/or not tracking to benchmark
* Take diligent notes on job statuses and overall financial health of the projects for assigned clients during tracker meetings
* Send recap email to align on updates discussed in meeting and ensure any required updates are executed in advance of the next report run/review
* Perform administrative duties involving data entry such as rate card entry, opening jobs, closing jobs, overall job status of projects, running unapproved time reports, and estimate creation/status
* Assist with adhoc requests come up for assigned accounts and review with Client Finance Manager for submission to client and/or Account Management teams
* Collaborate with other Client Finance Analysts within the group to raise any issues or similar road bumps if any should occur
* Review all transfer requests for accuracy and ensure appropriate approvals are in place before transferring to Omaha Shared Services team
* Work with Accounts Receivable team to ensure timely client payments and align to payment terms within Master Service Agreemen

Qualifications:
* Bachelors or Post Graduate Degree in accounting or finance with 3\-5 years of experience in FP\&A Operations, Finance and Accounts
* Having prior experience into R2R processes is (Preferred)
* Proficient in Advanced Excel and ability to quickly learn any new ERP or BI Tools
* Having Good Knowledge of US GAAP.
* Flexibility to take up different assignments and not limit oneself to specific set of activities
* Ability to work both independently and in a team oriented, collaborative environment
* Flexible and Result Oriented with Strong Written \& Oral Communication Skills

**Desirable Skills \& Attributes**

* **MS Excel** \- Basic knowledge in functions and formulas to perform VLOOKUP, pivot tables, creating charts, graphs, cand overall data capture
* Basic knowledge of PowerPoint
* Knowledge of SAP and/or business systems a plus
* Knowledge of Vantage a plus

**Teamwork skills**

* Strong communication skills
* Organizational skills
* Goal\-oriented mindset
* Detail oriented
* Acute attention to detail, with an emphasis on consistency and continuity
* Attentiveness and shows interest in the subject\- Expresses ideas clearly and accurately
* Team\-oriented mindset

 **What Makes Life at OGS Special:**


Trust Through Transparency \& Integrity: We keep things open and fair with easy access to leaders and HR, ways to share your feedback, and clear processes that ensure honesty and accountability.


Culture of Support \& Care: We prioritize your well\-being through comprehensive benefits (Group Personal Accident Insurance, Health Insurance, Group Term Insurance), flexible leave options (Care4Me, Me Day, paternity leave, maternity leave, bereavement leave), structured onboarding, and resources for emotional and physical health.


We also offer complimentary meals, sports facilities like a TT table, subsidized CULT gym membership, and cab services at subsidized rates—because your comfort matters. Our people\-centric policies drive equity for all.


Recognition \& Growth: We empower your career through sponsored learning, leadership development programs, internal mobility opportunities, and meaningful recognition—celebrating impact while enabling continuous growth.


At OGS India, we are not just hiring for a role—we are inviting you to join a purpose\-driven, people\-first culture where your growth, well\-being, and individuality are celebrated every step of the way.

description:
At PwC, our people in talent and development focus on finding, deploying, training and enabling talent through talent identification and enhancing employee skills and knowledge, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional growth. These individuals collaborate with subject matter specialists and project teams to strategize effective ways to locate, assess, educate and train employees, in line with market developments and firm strategy. As a talent generalist at PwC, you will focus on providing comprehensive talent support for leaders and guidance for employees, aligning talent strategies with business objectives. Your work will play a crucial role in improving employee retention, development and performance.
   

  

* Growing as a strategic advisor, you leverage your influence, expertise, and network to deliver quality results. You motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. As you increase in autonomy, you apply sound judgment, recognising when to take action and when to escalate. You are expected to solve through complexity, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly communicate how things fit together. Your ability to develop and sustain high performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our Firm.


**Skills**
 Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Craft and convey clear, impactful and engaging messages that tell a holistic story.
* Apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and/or opportunities.
* Validate outcomes with clients, share alternative perspectives, and act on client feedback.
* Direct the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging and uncertain situations.
* Deepen and evolve your expertise with a focus on staying relevant.
* Initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels.
* Make difficult decisions and take action to resolve issues hindering team effectiveness.
* Model and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.


 The Opportunity
   

  

 When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, you’ll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.
   

  

 As part of the Talent and Development team you serve as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders with a focus on accelerating the development of people. As a Senior Manager you lead large projects, innovate processes, and maintain operational excellence while interacting with clients at a senior level to drive project success. You collaborate with partners/leaders to identify issues, develop and execute action plans across various areas of people strategy including diversity, development, performance management, and rewards and recognition.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead large projects and maintain operational excellence
* Innovate processes and drive project success
* Interact with clients at a senior level
* Serve as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders
* Accelerate the development of people
* Identify issues and develop action plans
* Focus on diversity, development, performance management, and rewards
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement


 What You Must Have
   

  

* High School Diploma
* 6 years of Human Capital or PwC Experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* PHR or SPHR preferred
* Serving as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders
* Collaborating with partners/leaders on people strategy
* Leading talent management and succession planning
* Developing meaningful relationships with staff
* Focusing on diversity initiatives
* Applying coaching skills to increase effectiveness
* Managing resource requirements and project workflow

description:
**People \& Culture Business Partner** \[Pune \- Onsite]


**Who Are We**
==============

Hansen Technologies (ASX: HSN) is a global software and services provider, serving energy, water/utilities, and telecommunications industries. With customers in 80\+ countries, we foster collaboration across 26 global offices. From 5G advancements to renewable energy transitions, we empower customers to overcome challenges, innovate, and drive new business models.


At Hansen, we are also embedding AI enablement across our operations. From automating workflows and enhancing service delivery, to driving innovation in customer solutions, AI is shaping the next chapter of how we support our clients. With a focus on operational excellence and innovation, Hansen is using AI not just as a tool, but as a strategic enabler to deliver smarter, faster, and more resilient solutions for the future.  



**Why This Role Matters**
=========================

Be the trusted HR partner. Enable business success. Shape a competitive reward strategy.


As the HR Business Partner – India, you will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Hansen’s Compensation \& Benefits strategy for the region. Working closely with business leaders, Finance, and the global HR team, you will ensure that our reward programs are market\-aligned, compliant, and designed to attract, retain, and motivate top talent while supporting business growth.


Beyond advisory HR support, this role is pivotal in driving compensation benchmarking, benefits administration, and payroll governance, ensuring accuracy, equity, and a positive employee experience. Your expertise will directly influence how we reward performance, support employee wellbeing, and maintain Hansen’s position as an employer of choice in a competitive talent market.  



**What You’ll Do**
==================

* Act as the primary HR partner for India\-based teams and global stakeholders
* Lead Compensation \& Benefits activities including benchmarking, benefits administration, and reward support
* Ensure payroll inputs, employee data, and HR governance are accurate and compliant
* Provide expert guidance on HR policies, employee relations, performance, and disciplinary matters
* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws and regulatory requirements
* Support global HR cycles such as performance reviews, REM, engagement surveys, and audits
Collaborate cross‑regionally on global HR initiatives and continuous improvement.  
* 

**What You Bring**
==================

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Proven experience in an HR role, preferably as an HR Business Partner or HR Executive
* Strong knowledge of employment laws, regulations, and HR best practices in India
* Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and integrity
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive with a positive, can\-do approach.  
* 

This is full\-time onsite role based in our Pune office.  



**What Sets You Apart**
=======================

* Experience working within global or matrixed organizations
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS/HCM systems (Oracle or SAP preferred)
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.  
*

======================

Join us for a rewarding career with competitive compensation, leave entitlements, health coverage, and financial security. title: Compensation and Benefits Manager
description:
**Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning**

Pigment is the AI\-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature\-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.

With a team of 500\+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top\-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.  


We're offering a great position for a **Compensation and Benefits Manager** to join the People team. So, if you’ve got a way with Human Resources in a challenging environment and a genuine desire to build a first\-class People organization, we'd love to hear from you!

Reporting directly to our Head of People, this role will be responsible for managing the entire **Compensation \& Benefits strategy and execution, for all our markets.**
### **Who You Are:**


* You have significant experience in Compensation \& Benefits (8 years at least), and an in\-depth knowledge of C\&B practices, notably of the North American market
* You have worked in a fast\-growing and in an international environment
* You are structured and thorough with strong attention to details and data accuracy
* You are able to communicate efficiently and can make complicated concepts seem simple
* You are fun and enthusiastic, excited about being a core member of a rockstar team!
### **What You Will Do:**


* Upgrade our C\&B strategy (including equity) to attract and retain our talents, notably by benchmarking our practices with the best\-in class Tech companies
* Update and maintain our compensation ranges according to our strategy
* Manage our equity attributions
* Ensure our Benefits’ competitiveness, while keeping Pigment’s strategy and stage in mind
* Regular meetings and negotiations with Benefits providers, and handling relationships with them
* Deploy \& manage the annual increases’ process worldwide in the Pigment Application.
* Automate and optimize our C\&B processes, campaigns \& workflows
* Participate in global projects such as budget definition, forecasts and ad\-hoc analysis.
### **How we work**


* Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
* Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
* Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
* Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
* Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organizations
### **What we offer**

* Competitive compensation package
* Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
* We encourage you to take the time you need. When you work hard, we know you also need to rest, which is why we offer generous time off and parental leave policies
* Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, Toronto, Paris, and London
* High\-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
$200 \- $240 a year
*We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. description:
**Position Title:** Digital HR Analyst

**Position Type:** Regular \- Full\-Time


**Requisition ID:** 41957

 **Role Overview**


The Digital HR Analyst supports the design, configuration, testing, and optimization of HR technology systems whether through hands on implementation or strong business partnering with Technology resources. This role focuses on system functionality, access governance, elevated troubleshooting, and continuous enhancement.


This role is ideal for someone with strong hands\-on HR technology experience, playing a larger role in system configuration of HR processes, can communicate strongly to ensure HR needs translate into sound system logic and influence design, enjoys working cross functionally and has strong project management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**.

**Driving Technology Advancement**

* **Appropriately solve** HR problems with sustainable technical solutions in line with HR strategy, proactively managing impacts across systems, people and process.
* **Configure and maintain HR systems according to requirements,** updating settings, foundational data, workflows and security roles with precision.
* Serve as a **key escalation point for complex system issues**, partnering with IT and vendors to troubleshoot and resolve root causes.
* Own the **full UAT lifecycle** for their enhancements, including test script development, tester coordination, and validation that system updates support accurate and efficient business processes. Documents results, mitigates risks before deployment, identifies change impacts requiring communication or training, and surfaces process gaps to guide future enhancements.
* **Identify opportunities for automation in HR** processes and helps design and test workflow logic.
* Support system releases to ensure smooth deployment of mandatory and optional changes; identifying and mitigating impacts, sharing recommendations, and assisting with change management efforts,

 **Access Management**

* **Configure role\-based access structures** approved via governance or partners with necessary resources to do so, defining permission logic in line with the role.
* **Partner with IT** to align HR systems with **enterprise security standards**.

**User Enablement**

* **Keep clear and consistent technical documentation, job aids and user guides updated**, ensuring relevance and health of HR technology content.
* **Contributing content to, and answering questions from, Digital Training initiatives** to support HR staff in interacting with our technology.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* **Provide expert input on system capabilities, constraints, and configuration options** related to prioritized strategic initiatives.
* **Facilitate working sessions** to gather requirements, validate designs, and resolve issues where required.
* **Represent HR in digital or process improvement initiatives** as a subject matter contributor.

 **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3\-5 years of hands\-on HR Technology or business analyst experience.
* Certification in one or more of our key HR platforms (Time and attendance platform (UKG Workforce Pro is Preferred) and ServiceNow, Phenom, SuccessFactors).
* Strong understanding of HR processes (employee lifecycle, onboarding, timekeeping, talent management, performance, etc.)
* Proven ability to identify and manage change impacts of technology redesign.
* Strong ability to analyze issues, conduct root cause analysis and provide technically sound and sustainable solutions to problems, proactively mitigating impacts.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross functional teams.
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
* Enhancement coordination from facilitating requirement building for large process areas, design blueprinting, configuration, unit testing, user acceptance testing, change, deployment, operationalization.

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience working in an **agile** manner, i.e. **sprint\-based execution**.
* Experience using Agile tools to track work.

 **What Success Looks Like**

* **System changes deployed smoothly** with fewer defects and minimal post\-release issues because validation is thorough and aligned with business processes.
* **Recurring issues trend downward** because root causes are being addressed.
* **UAT cycles run efficiently**, with clear scripts, coordinated testers, and well documented results. **Defects are caught early**, reducing rework and preventing production disruptions.
* **Adoption improves** because systems are configured to meet broad business problems, have sustainable solutions the support HR processes, there are fewer process breakdowns and increased user experience.
* **SOPs, test scripts and configuration notes are current**, reducing knowledge gaps, streamlining project discovery and operations are more predictable/scalable.
* You are recognized as a trusted problem solver and **reliable partner** who understands both HR processes and technology.

title: HR Compliance Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment\-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.


This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast\-evolving compliance landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting \& Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:


	+ Gratuity Act
	+ Shops \& Establishments Act (state\-specific)
	+ POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
	+ Leave\-related statutory provisions
	+ Severance and separation\-related compliance
* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state\-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops \& Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment\-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time\-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry\-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time\-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations \& HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4\-7\+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state\-specific regulations including Shops \& Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgement and Integrity:** Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision\-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving:** Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** Builds strong cross\-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* **Adaptability:** Operates effectively in dynamic, fast\-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives and shifting priorities.
* **Operational Excellence:** Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Proficiency in HRIS (e.g., Workday), compliance reporting tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4\-7\+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state\-specific regulations including Shops \& Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgement and Integrity:** Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision\-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving:** Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** Builds strong cross\-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.

* **Technical Proficiency**: Proficiency in HRIS (e.g., Workday), compliance reporting tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Team Lead – Recruitment \& Operations is a high\-energy, execution\-focused role at Honest Hire. The primary responsibility is to lead a team of recruiters, drive daily hiring activity, and ensure monthly closure targets are consistently met. This person will also support HR operations deliverables for client accounts. We are not looking for someone who just manages — we need someone who rolls up their sleeves, pushes the team, and owns outcomes. If you are energetic, target\-driven, and have a solid grip on recruitment with some exposure to HR operations, this role is built for you.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Recruitment Management**

▪ Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for client mandates across industries including manufacturing, construction, IT, retail, and services.

▪ Ensure a minimum of 30 position closures per month across all client accounts.

▪ Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), employee referrals, headhunting, and talent databases.

▪ Conduct first\-level screening, competency\-based shortlisting, and coordinate interview scheduling with clients.

▪ Maintain and optimize JD quality, sourcing pipelines, and ATS data hygiene across all open positions.

▪ Track weekly sourcing metrics, submission ratios, interview\-to\-offer rates, and closure timelines per recruiter.

**B. HR Operations**

▪ Oversee HR operations deliverables for Honest Hire's client accounts including onboarding, documentation, offer letters, appointment letters, and HR policy rollouts.

▪ Coordinate payroll inputs (attendance, variable pay, new joiners, exits) with the payroll team and ensure timely monthly processing.

▪ Ensure all statutory compliance TATs are met — PF, ESIC, PT, TDS — with zero delays or errors.

▪ Manage employee lifecycle documentation: contracts, confirmation letters, increment letters, exit paperwork, and Full \& Final settlements.

▪ Handle client\-side HR escalations with ownership and timely resolution.

**C. Team Management**

▪ Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 3–5 recruiters and HR executives with weekly target setting and performance reviews.

▪ Conduct daily standups to track pipeline status, bottlenecks, and closures.

▪ Provide structured coaching and feedback; identify skill gaps and ensure continuous learning.

▪ Maintain team accountability through defined KPIs and weekly MIS reporting to the Founder.

**D. Client Management \& Business Support**

▪ Act as the primary SPOC for all recruitment and operations client accounts — own the relationship, communication, and SLA adherence.

▪ Share weekly and monthly MIS reports with clients covering hiring progress, ops compliance status, and escalation summaries.

▪ Identify upselling opportunities — e.g., converting a recruitment client to an HR operations client or vice versa.

▪ Support the Founder in onboarding new clients by setting up workflows, documentation frameworks, and team assignments quickly.

▪ Participate in client review meetings and business development discussions as required.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

▪ MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent (full\-time preferred).

▪ 3–7 years of experience in recruitment and HR operations, with at least 2 years in a team\-leading role.

▪ Proven track record of meeting bulk or high\-volume hiring targets (25\+ closures/month) in a consultancy or corporate setup.

▪ Hands\-on experience in HR operations: documentation, payroll inputs, and statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS).

▪ Experience working with small to mid\-size businesses or in an RPO/HR consultancy environment preferred.

▪ Languages: English \& Hindi (Marathi is an advantage).

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

▪ Prior experience in an HR consultancy, RPO, or staffing firm setup.

▪ Familiarity with ATS / HRMS platforms and structured recruitment reporting.

▪ Working knowledge of Labour Law, PF, ESIC, and PT compliance basics.

▪ Exposure to payroll coordination and full \& final settlement processes.

▪ Strong MS Excel and MIS reporting skills — ability to build and maintain dashboards.

▪ Network of candidates across industries: manufacturing, logistics, construction, retail, and IT.

title: Junior Plant & Machinery Valuation Engineer
description:
***Only freshers / students in last year should apply for this position.***

**Junior Valuer:**

As a junior plant and machinery valuer, your job profile would involve learning and assisting senior valuers in various aspects of the valuation process. Here's an overview of what your role might entail:

* **Assistance in Inspections**: You would assist senior valuers in conducting inspections of machinery and equipment. This involves learning how to assess the condition, functionality, and overall quality of the assets.
* **Data Collection**: Gathering relevant information and data about the machinery and equipment being valued. This could include specifications, maintenance records, usage history, and other pertinent details.
* **Market Research Support**: Assisting in market research activities to gather information on industry trends, pricing data, and comparable sales to help determine the market value of the assets.
* **Documentation and Record\-keeping**: Learning how to maintain accurate records and documentation of valuation activities, including inspection reports, data sheets, photographs, and other relevant documents.
* **Data Analysis**: Supporting senior valuers in analysing collected data and information to help determine the appropriate valuation methodologies and approaches to be used.
* **Report Preparation**: Assisting in the preparation of valuation reports under the guidance of senior valuers. This may involve compiling data, drafting sections of the report, and ensuring that all necessary information is included.
* **Client Interaction**: Learning how to effectively communicate with clients to understand their valuation needs, gather additional information, and provide updates on the valuation process.
* **Continued Learning**: Actively engaging in ongoing training and professional development activities to expand your knowledge of valuation methodologies, industry standards, and relevant regulations.
* **Quality Assurance**: Participating in quality assurance processes to ensure that valuation reports meet the required standards of accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* **Team Collaboration**: Collaborating with other team members, including senior valuers, engineers, and administrative staff, to ensure smooth coordination and execution of valuation projects.

Overall, as a junior plant and machinery valuer, your role would involve learning the ropes of the valuation process, gaining hands\-on experience under the guidance of experienced professionals, and gradually taking on more responsibilities as you develop your skills and expertise in the field.

* Prior experience in IT sales, telecalling, lead generation, or inside sales is preferred

title: Vice President - Customer Success
description:
**Job Title: VP – Customer Success**

**Location:** Bengaluru / India (with travel as required)  
**Organization:** Janitri Innovations Pvt. Ltd.  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About Janitri**

Janitri is a fast\-growing health\-tech company dedicated to improving maternal and newborn outcomes through innovative medical devices and digital health solutions. Our products are deployed across hospitals and healthcare systems, impacting thousands of pregnancies and births.

Over the years, Janitri has built a strong presence across **public and private healthcare ecosystems**, working closely with clinicians, hospitals, and government programs. With multiple recognitions and a growing footprint, we are now entering a **high\-growth phase focused on scale, adoption, and deeper impact**.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **VP – Customer Success** who can build and scale a **technology\-driven customer success function** that ensures strong adoption, retention, and impact across both enterprise healthcare customers and end users.

This role requires someone who understands that customer success is not just relationship management — it is about **building systems, leveraging technology, and driving outcomes at scale**.

You will work closely with product, clinical, sales, and operations teams to ensure our solutions are effectively adopted and deliver measurable value across both **B2B (hospitals, doctors)** and **B2C (end users / patients)** segments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the **end\-to\-end customer lifecycle** — onboarding, implementation, adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.
* Build and scale a **tech\-enabled customer success function**, including CRM systems, automation, dashboards, and customer health tracking.
* Drive **product adoption and utilization** across hospitals, clinicians, and end users.
* Design scalable onboarding, training, and engagement journeys for both enterprise customers and consumer users.
* Ensure high **customer retention, satisfaction, and lifetime value** across segments.
* Build and lead a high\-performing **Customer Success team**, including field teams, onboarding specialists, and account managers.
* Develop structured **customer feedback loops** and work closely with product and engineering teams to improve offerings.
* Monitor and optimize key metrics such as **NPS, retention, activation, engagement, and usage**.
* Identify risks proactively and ensure resolution to maintain strong customer relationships.
* Collaborate with sales and business teams to drive **upsell and cross\-sell opportunities**.
* Build deep relationships with hospital leadership, doctors, partners, and ecosystem stakeholders.
* Drive customer success strategies across both **public health programs and private healthcare institutions**.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* A leader who has **built or scaled customer success using technology and systems**, not just manual processes.
* Experience managing both **enterprise (B2B)** and **consumer (B2C)** customer success journeys.
* Strong understanding of **customer lifecycle, engagement, retention, and product adoption at scale**.
* Experience in **high\-growth environments**, building processes from scratch.
* Ability to balance **strategy with execution** in a fast\-paced setup.
* Strong stakeholder management across internal teams and external customers.
* High ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes and impact.

**Experience \& Qualification**

* 10–15 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, or Key Account Management.
* Proven experience in **building tech\-enabled customer success systems (CRM, automation, analytics tools)**.
* Experience in **healthcare, medtech, SaaS, or consumer tech platforms** preferred.
* Demonstrated exposure to both **enterprise customers and consumer\-facing products/services**.
* Experience leading and scaling teams across geographies.

**Why This Role Matters**

At Janitri, customer success directly translates to **clinical outcomes and lives impacted**. This role will define how our products are adopted, used, and scaled across healthcare systems and end users — making it one of the most critical leadership roles in the organization.

description:
* Min. 1 to 3 years experience
* Surat (GJ), India

#### **About Us**

* Optimumbrew Technology LLP is a fast\-growing IT company specializing in innovative, user\-focused mobile and web application development. Backed by a strong **“Get Things Done”** culture, we bring together top engineering talent to deliver high\-quality digital solutions for clients across the **USA, Canada, UK, Australia**, and other global markets. We focus on creativity, technology, and long\-term partnerships to help businesses achieve meaningful digital growth.
#### **Job Description**

* We are looking for a **Creative Content Creator \& Brand Storyteller** who can transform ideas into compelling narratives and produce content that drives attention, emotion, and engagement.
* You will play a key role in shaping how our brand speaks, looks, and connects with audiences across digital platforms.
#### **Primary Objectives**

* Develop and execute compelling brand storytelling that builds strong emotional connections with the target audience.
* Create high\-quality, engaging, and platform\-specific content that drives **attention, engagement, and brand recall**.
* Establish and maintain a **consistent brand voice and narrative** across all digital channels.
* Leverage **consumer psychology, trends, and data insights** to craft impactful content strategies.
* Experiment with innovative content formats and storytelling techniques to improve reach and engagement.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align content with **marketing goals and business objectives**.
* Continuously optimize content performance using analytics, feedback, and creative iterations.
#### **Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Develop compelling stories, scripts, and content concepts for brand, product, and marketing campaigns.
* Produce high\-quality content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, website, blogs, and marketing videos.
* Craft emotionally engaging narratives using audience psychology and empathy\-driven communication.
* Conduct market, competitor, and trend research to identify fresh content opportunities and insights.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to ideate, structure, and refine creative content experiences.
* Create and experiment with trending content formats: reels, shorts, memes, storytelling videos, hooks, and visual narratives.
* Collaborate with designers, product managers, and marketing teams to execute cohesive content strategies.
* Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) for content research, ideation, concept building, and scriptwriting.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice, tone, and visual storytelling style across all digital touchpoints.
* Track performance metrics (views, engagement, watch\-time, shares) and recommend creative improvements.
* Assist in planning and executing creative campaigns that strengthen brand image and audience connection.
* Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, audience expectations, and communication objectives.
#### **Technical Skills You Should Have**

* Strong command of scriptwriting, storytelling, and narrative structuring for digital platforms.
* Proficiency in creating content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, websites, and blogs.
* Understanding of consumer psychology, emotional communication, and engagement\-driven content creation.
* Ability to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) for ideation, research, and content enhancement.
* Familiarity with short\-form video formats, hooks, pacing, and visual storytelling techniques.
* Basic knowledge of video editing tools (Premiere Pro, CapCut, VN, or similar) is an added advantage.
* Ability to conduct market research, competitor analysis, and trend identification.
* Strong grasp of social media algorithms, content patterns, and best\-performing formats.
* Experience in writing SEO\-friendly blog content (optional but beneficial).
* Ability to collaborate using tools like Notion, Google Workspace, Figma, or project management platforms.
#### **Key Expertise**

* Storytelling \& Scriptwriting: Ability to craft compelling narratives, hooks, and emotional scripts for digital platforms.
* Creative Concept Development: Skilled in generating unique ideas, content angles, and storytelling formats.
* Social Media Content Creation: Strong understanding of creating platform\-specific content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and blogs.
* Audience Psychology: Ability to decode user emotions, motivations, and behaviors to create relatable content.
* Trend Identification: Expertise in analyzing and leveraging social media trends, formats, and viral patterns.
* Visual Thinking: Strong sense of visual storytelling, scene setup, pacing, and message flow.
* AI\-Assisted Creativity: Proficient in using AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) for ideation, scriptwriting, and content enhancement.
* Market \& Competitor Research: Ability to identify industry gaps, opportunities, and creative direction ideas.
* Content Optimization: Skilled in improving engagement through hooks, structure, captions, CTAs, and formats.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Ability to work closely with design, product, and marketing teams for seamless execution.
#### **Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mass Communication, Marketing, Psychology, Design, Journalism, Media Studies, or related fields (preferred but not mandatory).
* 1–3 years of experience in content creation, digital storytelling, social media content, or creative strategy.
* Strong portfolio showcasing storytelling skills, content creativity, and digital platform understanding.
* Exceptional freshers with a strong Instagram presence, creative portfolio, or storytelling samples are encouraged to apply.
#### **Experience**

* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in content creation, storytelling, social media content, or digital marketing.
* Experience producing content for platforms like Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, websites, and blogs.
* Prior experience in creating scripts, short\-form videos, reels/shorts, or brand narratives is highly preferred.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams (design, product, marketing) to execute creative ideas.
* Exceptional freshers with a strong creative portfolio or high\-engagement Instagram presence may also apply.
#### **Benefits**

* 22 Paid Leaves
* 5 Days Working

* Health Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Pension Scheme
* Statutory Benefits (PF \& ESIC)
* Salary on time
* Yearly Picnic
* Annual Sports Day
* Monthly Events
* Festival Celebrations

**Company:** Teslead Equipments Private Limited  
**Location:** Sidco Industrial Estate, Malumichampatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Quality Control  
**Reports To:** QA/QC Manager / Production Manager

**Job Summary:**

Teslead Equipments Private Limited is looking for a detail\-oriented and responsible QC Inspector with strong documentation skills. The candidate will be responsible for inspecting raw materials, in\-process components, and finished products to ensure compliance with quality standards, while maintaining accurate inspection records and reports.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform incoming, in\-process, and final inspections as per quality standards.
* Verify dimensions, tolerances, and specifications using measuring instruments.
* Ensure products meet company and customer quality requirements.
* Prepare and maintain inspection reports and quality documentation.
* Record non\-conformities and coordinate corrective actions with production team.
* Maintain calibration records of measuring instruments.
* Ensure compliance with ISO and internal quality procedures.
* Prepare Quality Control documents such as:
* Inspection Reports
* Material Test Certificates (MTC) verification
* Final Inspection Reports (FIR)
* Quality Checklists
* Dispatch Clearance Documents
* Support audits (internal and external) with proper documentation.
* Maintain proper filing and traceability of quality records.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Diploma / ITI in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* 1–4 years of experience in QC inspection in manufacturing industry.
* Freshers can also apply

**Required Skills:**

* Knowledge of engineering drawings and technical specifications.
* Proficiency in using measuring tools such as Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Dial Gauge, etc.
* Basic understanding of ISO quality systems.
* Strong documentation and record\-keeping skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word).

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in equipment or machinery manufacturing industry.
* Knowledge of welding inspection basics.
* Understanding of quality standards and compliance requirements.

Carbon Secure India Pvt. Ltd. (CSI) is a fast\-growing climate\-tech startup building a large\-scale biochar carbon removal project on a 60 acre site.

Using paddy straw and rice husk as feedstock, we operate artisanal kilns scaled to industrial levels in Ludhiana, Punjab.

Carbon is sequestered through innovative burial of biochar in underground vertical silos for durable, high\-integrity credits.

Commercial production commences in June 2026, with a targeted scale\-up to 50 MT of biochar per day by year\-end.

We are now enhancing our infrastructure with an innovative molten salt pyrolysis process that will scale considerably at exceptional pace.

This is a hands\-on role ideal for someone who enjoys end\-to\-end recruitment, thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, and wants to grow with a high\-impact climate\-tech company.

title: AGILE DELIVERY SENIOR MANAGER
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


You are joining BCG’s Agile Center of Excellence (CoE), a 70\+ expert global Coaching and Scrum Lead team responsible for enabling the agility and high\-performance delivery of BCG’s internal Digital Product Organization. The Agile CoE is an expert product enablement function aligned organizationally to Global IT, part of BCG’s global internal Business Services Teams (BST) which operate BCG’s business.

  

The Digital Product Organization (DPO) is a 1300\+ person cross\-functional product delivery, tech \& engineering organization. It is comprised of 16 Product Portfolios, 120\+ product squads and 5 centers of excellence, responsible for driving digital product enablement for all internal BCG business functions (HR, Marketing, Legal, Risk, Finance, IT, etc.). This organization was formed in 2020 as part of a full\-scale business agility transformation, sponsored by the CIO, CFO and COO and delivered by BCG’s best\-in\-class Agile strategy and implementation consulting team. Each Product Portfolio is led by a dedicated Product Portfolio leader with direct alignment to the senior executive of their business function. A Product Portfolio is comprised of 3 – 15 squads, each managing 1 or more products. This organization follows a consistent Agile operating model with standards and best practices designed and governed by the Agile COE. As Agile Delivery Manager (Global Senior Manager) you will:

 **Drive End\-to\-End Delivery (Primary Focus):**

* Own and drive **end\-to\-end delivery** of complex initiatives, programs, and product increments from planning to production and stabilization.
* Ensure **predictable, timely, and high\-quality delivery** of initiatives, epics, and features aligned with business priorities and roadmaps.
* Manage **dependencies, risks, and constraints across squads,** platforms, and stakeholders to ensure smooth execution.
* Own delivery planning, sequencing, milestones, and execution tracking across teams.
* Ensure a clear **path to production**, including operational readiness and post\-release follow\-up.
* **Facilitate Agile Delivery (Supporting Focus):**
* Apply agile practices pragmatically to support delivery outcomes rather than acting as an Agile Coach or Scrum Master.
* Work with Product Owners and technical leads to ensure delivery plans are realistic, prioritized, and executable.
* Support teams using agile ceremonies and artifacts to improve delivery predictability and flow.
* Improve delivery processes and tooling to reduce execution friction and enable faster, reliable releases.

**Release Planning and Management:**

* Plan and manage release execution, including readiness, cutover, and coordination with L2/L3 support teams.
* Ensure releases meet quality, risk, and compliance expectations.
* Support post\-release activities to ensure stability and business continuity.

**Risk and Issue Management:**

* Proactively identify delivery risks and issues that may impact timelines, scope, or quality.
* Drive mitigation plans and escalate when necessary to ensure delivery commitments are met.
* Resolve execution blockers by coordinating across teams and leadership.

**Metrics, Tracking, and Reporting:**

  

* Track and report delivery metrics such as milestones, dependencies, predictability, lead time, and throughput.
* Use data\-driven insights to identify delivery bottlenecks and areas for execution improvement.
* Provide clear delivery status, risks, and forecasts to senior stakeholders and portfolio leadership.
* Create dashboards and reports that give transparency into delivery progress and outcomes

**Team and Stakeholder Enablement:**

* Partner with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, and business stakeholders to align delivery with business objectives.
* Manage stakeholder expectations through clear communication, transparency, and realistic planning.
* Foster collaboration across squads while maintaining delivery accountability.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify opportunities to improve delivery effectiveness, execution models, and ways of working.
* Support teams in refining processes to improve efficiency, quality, and predictability.
* Apply lessons learned from delivery outcomes to improve future execution.

  

What You'll Bring

**13–15\+ years of experience across multitude of delivery management roles (e.g., Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Manager, Project/Program Manager, Release Train Engineer (RTE), Technology Delivery Lead).**

* **10\+ years of relevant experience leading complex technology or digital delivery initiatives in large\-scale environments.**
* **Demonstrated agile coaching capabilities combined with 2–3 years of solid project and program management experience to support effective delivery governance.**

* Proven track record of driving end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise\-scale digital and technology programs, from planning through production and stabilization.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models with the ability to apply them pragmatically to meet business objectives and execution outcomes.

 **Certifications (Preferred):**

* **Agile Delivery Management certification.**
* **SAFe RTE / SAFe Scrum Master / SAFe Advanced Scrum Master certification.**
* **PMP certification.**
* **Scrum certifications (PSM, CSM) considered a value add but not a primary requirement. Skills \& Experience:**

* **Extensive experience delivering agile programs using industry\-standard tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent platforms.**
* Experience working with OKRs; exposure to AI / GenAI\-driven portfolios is a strong advantage.
* Deep understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, including release management, path to production, and operational readiness.
* Proven ability to manage complex interdependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations across large, matrixed organizations.
* Strong background in technology\-enabled business transformation and enterprise\-scale delivery execution.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels.
* Experience working in professional services or client\-facing environments preferred.

  

Who You'll Work With

* Product Owners and Engineering teams to ensure delivery execution aligns with business priorities.
* Portfolio Product Leaders, Technical Area Leads, and Chapter Leads to manage delivery dependencies and outcomes.
* Other Delivery Managers to ensure consistency and best practices across initiatives

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
